description: List imported backups — backup files brought in from Object Storage, account-level (GET /mysql/v1/imported-backups): name, zoneCode, size, status (IMPORTING|AVAILABLE|FAILED), engineVersion. Sort fields: name, importedDateTime, size.

pageNo.description: Page number, 0-based (default 0 — note: unlike the legacy Ncloud APIs)

sort.description: Sort keys 'field,asc|desc' (repeatable; allowed fields per tool)

name: ncloud_serverless_list_imported_backups
